## Account Metrics

One account's revenue health, read live from its realm: MRR (active and trial subscriptions, yearly prices divided by 12), ARR, Outstanding (what is still owed on open invoices, tax included), Collected (paid invoices) and the count of overdue invoices. A new payment or subscription updates the strip without a reload.

```gts
import { AccountMetrics } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/crm/components/account-metrics';

<AccountMetrics @account={{@model.account}} @context={{@context}} />
```

The invoices and subscriptions are queried by the account's id, so only that account's records load. The sums are in the account's currency (its subscriptions', else its invoices'); amounts in another currency are left out rather than added as if they were the same money.

### Example

Acme Industries, with its Workspace Pro and data add-on subscriptions and its invoices.

### Non-goals

Cross-account rollups such as pipeline value or win rate. Storing these numbers on any card.
